wins: Maintained disciplined attack tempo across the single episode and achieved a high reward score (90.00) despite no success with the final objective.
Consistent use of mentor assistance (10 calls) ensured guided decision-making during critical transitions, preventing redundant or unsafe actions.
fails: Objective completion failed (0.00% success), indicating gaps in exploitation strategy or post-exploitation control.
Recurring dependency on mentor intervention suggests core tactics are not yet internalized, increasing operational overhead.
key_outcomes.summary: The run demonstrated disciplined reconnaissance and decision logging, but the team failed to convert visibility into a successful exploitation, highlighting the need to reinforce privilege escalation and mission execution protocols.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to escalate privileges after initial access attempts, leading to a dead end before achieving objective control.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service on port 22 is identified during enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Conduct targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts and capture banner information

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance enumerates Windows domain controllers without known credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to LDAP/SAMRPC enumeration to collect usable account metadata before brute forcing

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial access yields low-privileged shell but no persistence
skill_cards.then_action: Immediately collect host configuration (users, scheduled tasks, services) to identify privilege escalation opportunities

memory_ops.reason: High confidence in SSH enumeration routine after reliable banner collection across the episode
Consistent need to document host posture after initial low-privileged access
